analysis_contract.claim_scope: this frozen H16 fixture, schedule, reader pin, accounting, and observed positions 1..16 only
forbidden_interpretations: no structural or asymptotic complexity claim
do not mix H16 session-gross with any other cell or runtime axis
primary_outputs: arm-by-position mean F, R, and gross for each new baseline
paired-session cumulative C_w differences and ratios among all three new arms
paired-session cumulative C_w differences and ratios versus each frozen H16 reference arm
exact-answer correctness by arm and horizon
analysis_contract.quality_noninferiority: paired exact-answer difference; lower 95% CI must be >= -0.05
analysis_contract.uncertainty: paired-session percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, two-sided 95% CI

approval_gate.execution_source_freeze: must be created after approval and before the first probe/model turn; the current runner is a non-executing skeleton
required_user_approvals: 576 planned valid turns and 720 model-spend attempt cap
144 zero-token infra failures and 864 total API-call cap
three exact arm operationalizations including W=4 and no compactor calls
zero K-ARC MCP calls in all E11 arms
separate exact-pin provider probe capped at 2 attempts
reuse of frozen H16 control rows and their later-batch limitation
planning token scenarios and unavailable exact dollar amount
stop without substitution on usage-limit or any pin/hash mismatch

attempt_contract.infra_failure_definition: failed call with zero normalized model usage
attempt_contract.model_spend_definition: successful turn or any failed call with non-zero normalized model usage

cost_plan.dollar_cost_note: ChatGPT subscription telemetry did not expose actual billed dollars; retry usage may exceed the planning scenarios but not the attempt caps
cost_plan.scenario_method: stateless proxy = H16 rag-bm25 position-1 mean x192 (2,346,160); sliding proxy = H16 rag-bm25 positions 1..4 plus position-5 mean repeated through position 16 (14,252,483); full-history bracketed by the two observed H16 arm gross totals (41,237,867..55,942,953)

decision_contract.null_disposition: failure to trigger a rewrite rule is not evidence of K-ARC superiority

paper2_premise_collapse.cost_condition: at H=16, for full-history minus each of karc-full and rag-bm25, the paired 95% CI upper bound is <0 for every w in {0,0.1,1}
paper2_premise_collapse.label: PAPER2_PREMISE_REWRITE_REQUIRED
paper2_premise_collapse.quality_condition: full-history minus each reference arm has paired correctness 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05
paper2_premise_collapse.required_action: Paper 2 may not retain a memory-system-necessity premise; rewrite the thesis around the trivial full-history result and report it first

decision_contract.quality_guard: if a cost-cheaper arm fails the -5pp paired correctness margin, report its token curve but withhold a cost-optimal recommendation

stateless_state_necessity_failure.condition: at H=16 stateless-rag has paired 95% CI upper bound <0 versus H16 rag-bm25 for every w and paired correctness lower bound >= -0.05
stateless_state_necessity_failure.label: SESSION_STATE_NECESSITY_CLAIM_REMOVE
stateless_state_necessity_failure.required_action: remove any claim that session state is necessary on this cell; retain only accounting observations that survive

full-history.corpus_supply: all 408 fixture artifacts / 35,128 fixture tokens at session start
full-history.cross_turn_state: all prior task messages and answers retained

sliding-window-compaction.corpus_supply: current turn frozen H16 BM25 plan
sliding-window-compaction.cross_turn_state: most recent four completed task/evidence/answer turns replayed verbatim
sliding-window-compaction.eviction: drop oldest completed turn when the four-turn window is full
sliding-window-compaction.provider_session: new isolated thread per turn with deterministic window replay
sliding-window-compaction.semantic_summary: none; no extra compactor model call

stateless-rag.corpus_supply: current turn frozen H16 BM25 plan
stateless-rag.eviction: all prior turn state absent by construction

design.objective: test trivial full-context, bounded-runtime, and no-session-state baselines before making Paper 2 lifecycle-cost claims
design.reuse_definition: fraction of non-initial session tasks whose gold artifact was gold for an earlier task in the same session
design.stateless_rag_difference_from_h16_rag_bm: H16 rag-bm25 used one persistent 16-turn provider conversation and therefore carried prior prompts, BM25 evidence, answers, and provider cache; stateless-rag creates a fresh isolated provider session for every turn and supplies only that turn's frozen BM25 evidence

persist: failure category and hashed error digest

reference_cell.execution_batch_difference: E11 baseline rows are a later execution batch; comparisons are permitted only because fixture, schedule, reader pin, reasoning, auth mode, and accounting are exact and their hashes are frozen

before_first_turn: stop until the user explicitly approves this E11-BASE3 execution and caps
stop if Codex CLI is not exactly 0.144.5
stop if gpt-5.6-luna/high under ChatGPT subscription cannot be selected; do not substitute
stop on fixture, H16 schedule, schema, reference raw, or execution-source hash mismatch
stop if the approved exact-pin probe reports a usage-limit or quota block
during_run: stop globally on any usage-limit or quota error; do not switch provider, model, account, or runtime
stop globally on reported-model or reasoning-pin mismatch
stop globally on missing or internally inconsistent token telemetry
stop globally on context overflow or runtime truncation; do not shorten, compact, or substitute the registered arm
stop globally if any E11 arm records a K-ARC MCP search/get call
stop globally if state-window/session-isolation instrumentation violates the registered arm contract
stop when any registered attempt cap is reached
stopping_contract.task_errors: grade and retain normalized metadata; task-answer error alone is not a stop
